info.title: ZeeSpare API
info.description:
Bulk upserts and lists of ZeeSpare master data and demand history, per organization.
Read saved transfer handoffs and batches with explicit organization-wide transfer_handoffs:read permission. Stock commitments remain as-of; reads never reserve stock or execute transfers.
Read saved purchase handoffs and batches with explicit organization-wide purchase_handoffs:read permission. These are planning evidence, not external orders.

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer maqdar_sk_…`; an owner or admin creates keys in Settings. Keys are scoped (master_data:read, master_data:write, transactions:read, transactions:write, purchase_handoffs:read, purchase_handoffs:acknowledge, transfer_handoffs:read, transfer_handoffs:acknowledge, event_purchase_handoffs:read, event_purchase_handoffs:acknowledge, excess_disposition_handoffs:read, excess_disposition_handoffs:acknowledge, network_handoffs:read, network_handoffs:acknowledge), expire, and stop working when their creator is no longer an owner or admin.

Upserts are `POST /{resource}:upsert` with `{"records": [...]}`: all or nothing, by natural key, with the same field rules as the import wizard. Every record carries the same fields; a field left out keeps its stored value; null or "" clears a nullable field. Decimals are accepted as JSON numbers or strings and always returned as canonical strings. Load parents before children (x-maqdar-load-order).

Errors are RFC 9457 problems (`application/problem+json`) with a stable `code` and a `request_id`. Honour `Retry-After` on 409, 429 and 503.

Documentation: https://github.com/aqoza/MAQDAR/blob/main/docs/api.md

tags.name: Network handoffs
tags.description: Complete network planning approvals and copied batches with currency-separated freight and independent live selection.

tags.name: Disposition handoffs
tags.description: Original disposition evidence and exact reference inventory values, with separate live source context.

tags.name: Event purchase handoffs
tags.description: Saved full event-adjusted selections and baseline comparisons; live selection stays separate.

tags.name: Master data
tags.description: Calendars, locations, items, suppliers and rates.

tags.name: Transfer handoffs
tags.description: Saved transfer planning packages; original evidence and live selection are separate.

tags.description: Read-only saved planning evidence and live selection.

x-maqdar-scopes.master_data:read: List master data (calendars, locations, brands, items, suppliers, …).
x-maqdar-scopes.transactions:read: List demand history, stock snapshots, open orders and receipts.
x-maqdar-scopes.transactions:write: Upsert demand history, stock snapshots, open orders and receipts.
x-maqdar-scopes.purchase_handoffs:read: Read saved purchase handoffs and batches across the organization; no order execution.
x-maqdar-scopes.purchase_handoffs:acknowledge: Append external receipt or rejection reports for saved purchase handoffs and batches across the organization; no order execution.
x-maqdar-scopes.transfer_handoffs:read: Read saved transfer handoffs and batches across the organization; no reservation or transfer execution.
x-maqdar-scopes.transfer_handoffs:acknowledge: Append external receipt or rejection reports for saved transfer handoffs and batches across the organization; no reservation or transfer execution.
x-maqdar-scopes.event_purchase_handoffs:read: Read saved event purchase handoffs and batches across the organization, including adjusted selections and baseline comparisons; no order execution.
x-maqdar-scopes.event_purchase_handoffs:acknowledge: Append external receipt or rejection reports for saved event purchase handoffs and batches across the organization; no transmission or order execution.
x-maqdar-scopes.excess_disposition_handoffs:read: Read saved disposition handoffs and batches across the organization, including retained evidence after source deletion; no returns, write-offs or stock movements.
x-maqdar-scopes.excess_disposition_handoffs:acknowledge: Append external receipt or rejection reports for saved disposition handoffs and batches across the organization; no returns, write-offs or stock movements.
x-maqdar-scopes.network_handoffs:read: Read saved whole-network handoffs and copied batches across the organization, including every branch and retained evidence after source deletion; no reservations or transfer execution.
x-maqdar-scopes.network_handoffs:acknowledge: Append whole-package receipt or rejection reports for saved network handoffs and batches across the organization; no reservations or transfer execution.

get.description:
Organization-wide access requires purchase_handoffs:read. Includes current and historical records. GET and HEAD never create orders, reserve quantities, acknowledge transmission or change evidence. Responses are private and no-store.

Newest created_at first, then UUID ascending. Pass next_cursor unchanged with the same created_since until null; limit may change. created_since is inclusive and creation-based, not a selection-change feed. as_of excludes later creation times but does not provide transaction snapshot isolation: late commits or deletions can affect traversal. Reconcile with overlapping creation windows and deduplicate by ID; re-read known IDs for current selection. Unknown, repeated or empty parameters return 400.

parameters.name: created_since
parameters.description: Inclusive RFC 3339 timestamp with offset. Keep unchanged while following a cursor.

200.description: A page of saved summaries and live selection.

Organization-wide scoped API-key access. Events are append-only caller reports and do not verify external acceptance, create orders, change inbound or approvals, or alter saved evidence. Historical packages are eligible. Batch reports never propagate to individual handoffs or overlapping batches. recorded_at is server recording time; no global external delivery state is inferred.

Newest recorded_at then UUID ascending. The cursor binds organization, resource and parent. Its creation-time upper bound is not a transactional snapshot; concurrent commits/deletions may affect traversal. Reconcile with overlap and deduplicate by event ID. Only limit and cursor are accepted.

GET/HEAD require purchase_handoffs:read; POST requires purchase_handoffs:acknowledge. Existing events have no PUT/PATCH/DELETE routes. All responses are no-store. Browser sessions are not API credentials.

Limit.name: limit

TransactionLimit.name: limit

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page, unchanged, with the same other parameters.

UpdatedSince.name: updated_since
UpdatedSince.description: Only records changed at or after this instant (RFC 3339 with an offset).

To.name: to
To.description: Last demand date (inclusive); at most 366 days in all.

X-Request-Id.description: The request id; quote it to support.

NotFound.description: No record with this ID in the key organization.

UpsertBadRequest.description: The body is not valid JSON (invalid_json), or the URL has a query string (invalid_parameter).

Conflict.description: Another write holds the organization, or the data changed (acknowledgement_conflict, import_in_progress, busy, write_conflict).

WorkCalendarsRecord.description: Working-day calendars: weekend days and whether a country's public holidays apply. Locations and suppliers without a calendar use their country's default. Every field is always present; decimals are canonical strings.

country_code.description: Country whose public holidays apply (sector all).

observe_public_holidays.description: The country's public holidays are non-working days (needs country_code).

is_active.description: false for calendars no longer used.

updated_at.description: Last change (UTC, microseconds). Ignored when the record is sent back.

WorkCalendarsUpsert.description: Working-day calendars: weekend days and whether a country's public holidays apply. Locations and suppliers without a calendar use their country's default.
